## Observed Facts

**Count.** Data Scope: BGL dataset, `ts` from 2005-06-01 up to but not including 2005-07-01, message substring `ciod` (case-insensitive). There are **20,217 Log Entries** in this scope [E1]. By component: APP 13,409 [E1], KERNEL 6,803 [E1], MMCS 5 [E1]. These are Log Entries, not incidents.

**First match.** Ordered by timestamp, the first match is line 4988, at 2005-06-03 16:17:40.190183 [E2]. It is an APP FATAL entry on node R26-M0-NC-I:J18-U11:
`ciod: Error loading /p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor: invalid or missing program image, No such file or directory` [E2]

**Just before (lines 4978–4987) [E3]:**
- Lines 4978–4982 (KERNEL, INFO, node R16-M1-N2-C:J17-U01, 16:12:35): a series of `CE sym 2, at 0x..., mask 0x..` correctable-error messages [E3].
- Line 4983 (16:12:36.079): `total of 31 ddr error(s) detected and corrected` on the same node [E3].
- Lines 4984–4987 (KERNEL, INFO, nodes R22-M0-*, 16:16:26): four `generating core.N` messages (core.257, core.385, core.65, core.1) [E3].

**Just after (lines 4989–4998) [E3]:** The same `ciod: Error loading ... raptor` FATAL message repeats across many nodes in about 0.3 seconds (16:17:40.232 to 16:17:40.486). The nodes are R26-M0-NC, R26-M0-N8, R26-M0-N4, R26-M0-N0, R27-M1-NC and R27-M1-N8, all on the J18 link positions [E3]. Line 4998 is the last line in the fetched window, so the total number of entries in this burst is not established here.

## Hypotheses

- The `ciod` FATAL burst looks like a job launch on the RAPTOR job (65641) failing because its program image `/p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor` was missing or invalid at load time. The fact that the same error hits many nodes within a fraction of a second suggests a single launch attempt, not independent hardware faults. This is inferred from the message text and timing only.
- The earlier KERNEL messages (correctable DDR errors and core dumps on other nodes) are in the same time window, but the logs don't show a causal link to the `ciod` error. Node R16 and the R22 nodes differ from the R26/R27 nodes that failed the load.

## Unknowns

- Why the image was missing: the logs contain no file-system or job-submission entries for `/p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/`.
- Whether the 16:16:26 core dumps and the 16:12 DDR-correction messages affected the job's launch. The logs don't establish this.
- The full size of the 16:17:40 burst. I only fetched 10 lines after the first match.
- I did not check what the 6,803 KERNEL `ciod`-matching entries say. They may be a different failure, and I have not examined them.

## Next Step

Search for other entries about the same job path to see whether this is one launch failing or a recurring pattern. For example, run `search_logs` on BGL with query `RAPTOR/65641` (no time filter), then `trend` by day on the query `invalid or missing program image` to check whether it recurs across June 2005.
